related.title: Alvin 載人科學潛器
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以接頭兩側的壓差概念建立起點，接到密封接合面的尺寸鏈的系統介面，最後用水密與電氣證據分列整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Pressure differential across connectors, connect through Sealing-interface tolerance chain, then integrate evidence using Separate sealing/electrical evidence. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 海洋感測器水密接頭
history.text: 本專題以接頭兩側的壓差概念建立起點，接到密封接合面的尺寸鏈的系統介面，最後用水密與電氣證據分列整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Pressure differential across connectors, connect through Sealing-interface tolerance chain, then integrate evidence using Separate sealing/electrical evidence. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以接頭截面圖和常壓模型追蹤水密、接觸電阻、拉力和時效，分開外觀與功能驗證。 在水密接頭與低能量量測室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Use connector sections and ambient models to track sealing, contact resistance, tension and ageing, separating appearance from function. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Watertight-connector low-energy metrology studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
